The provided function does not correctly implement the instruction to find the maximum difference between two numbers in the array. The function incorrectly calculates the sum of adjacent elements (`arr[i+1] + arr[i]`) instead of the difference (`arr[i+1] - arr[i]` or `abs(arr[i+1] - arr[i])`). Additionally, the logic does not account for the absolute difference nor the maximum possible difference between any two elements in the array, which should be `max(arr) - min(arr)` (assuming the order does not matter). For the given input `[5, 3, 17, 11, 9]`, the correct maximum difference is `14` (17 - 3), but the function would return incorrect results due to the summation error. Thus, the response is largely inaccurate.
